needs_human.note: Start placement is now deduplicated by resetKey, including the frame start times. Frames refetched with the same starts no longer place the list again; the spec's Terms treat this as not an arrival, but it also changes SPEC-ADDON-152 §1.3 placement behaviour.; The opening's at-once request waits for the Visual Index answer on native panels with the policy on (F4).

The start reading of a native video waits for the Visual Index answer (layoutSettled). This wait is not in the spec or the touch points.; A .loft re-show skips the start placement (no following reset and no placement at the playing row).
